title: A space probe touched an asteroid millions of miles away
description: In October 2020, NASA's OSIRIS-REx spacecraft touched the surface of asteroid Bennu. It collected the largest sample returned from beyond the Moon.

shots.narration: Watch a robot arm touch an asteroid more than 320 million kilometres from Earth.
The OSIRIS-REx spacecraft reached Bennu, a rubble-pile asteroid about 500 metres wide, in December 2018.
Bennu has about a 1-in-2,700 chance of hitting Earth in the year 2182.
The spacecraft studied the asteroid's surface to prepare for its brief contact with the ground.
On 20 October 2020, its arm touched the surface for a few seconds.
The surface gave way like a ball pit, and the arm sank about half a metre before thrusters pulled it back.
The spacecraft gathered pristine material from the surface during those brief seconds of contact.
It collected 121.6 grams, the largest sample returned from beyond the Moon.
The sample capsule landed in the Utah desert on 24 September 2023, carrying rocks with water-bearing minerals and organic molecules.
